summary_1line: Karna insists on giving alms even to Indra but, warned by Surya, plans to trade his divine earrings and armor for Indra’s unfailing spear.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant Sun-god appears before Karna in a dream, warning him not to give away his shining earrings and armor.
Karna stands with folded hands beneath the blazing light of Surya, vowing he would rather die than refuse a Brahmana seeking alms.
The thousand-rayed Surya suddenly vanishes into the sky as Karna resolves to bargain with Indra for a deadly celestial dart.
